turns.question: Of the people who applied to work here between 25 September and 2 October 2026, what share were still in the running at the end of 4 October?
turns.answer: Of the 6 candidates who applied from 25 September to 2 October 2026, 4 were not rejected at the end of 4 October 2026 (2 hired, 1 in interview, 1 in screen) and 2 had been rejected, so 4 of 6 were still in the running if hired counts, or 2 of 6 if only candidates still in the process count. Late: recruitment.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
